task: Level-20 capstone: arbitrary-precision decimal (Dec) from scratch on BigInteger, with BigDecimal differential tests and a mutation check
reasoning_summary: Represented a decimal as BigInteger unscaled plus int scale and centralised all rounding in one applyRounding function shared by setScale, round, divide and sqrt. Division picks a scale so the truncated quotient has precision or precision+1 digits, then rounds from the true remainder and strips zeros only when exact. Tests combine literal rounding tables and half-way ties with seeded differential runs against java.math.BigDecimal; a mutation pass exposed an untested sqrt tie case which was then covered.
